_comment: Provenance contract (Part II §5.1). The frozen embeddings in clustering.jsonl were produced by feeding `<title> ×N + first K chars of body` to gte-small. If ANY of these four values changes, the fixture embeddings are stale and MUST be regenerated via scripts/generate_embeddings.py. The provenance assertion in conftest.py checks this file against the worker's configured values and fails LOUD (not silent) on mismatch.
